decisions.reason: As a low-cost software component tightly linked to the firm's geospatial integration business and given only one year of market evidence, it is worth keeping this option open.
The digital twin service is strategically attractive but more resource-intensive and market-uncertain than a simple component, so it should be kept for now while demand clarifies.
This identity delegation service fits enterprise integration needs but overlaps with the firm's other identity offering, so it remains a viable option yet faces the highest near-term pruning risk.
An open GIS application framework strongly matches the firm's open, extensible, R&D-driven positioning, and the cost of continuing it is likely modest relative to its platform upside.

Because the new GIS-focused identity and access service was explicitly launched and supports seamless GeoIT integration for core customers, management would likely continue it while the market opportunity matures.
